instagram.caption:
In Metal Gear Solid (1998), Psycho Mantis reads your PlayStation memory card and comments on the other Konami games you've saved.

He then asks you to put your controller on the floor and makes it move with his "psychic power", using the rumble.

He dodges every attack because he reads your inputs. The fix: plug your controller into port 2.

Did you figure it out on your own back then?
